lines.t: (Verse 1)
YahuShua,
You've always held me close.
You're the one who has loved me most.
Through every dark night and every storm,
You're the one who has kept me warm.
You didn't push me away when I did wrong.
You corrected me because of Your love.
(Pre-Chorus)
Through every day,
Through every mistake I made,
You never let me go.
When I was saddest and at my low,
You reminded me of Your love
That would never let me go.
(Chorus)
You never let me go — when I was sinking low,
Your arms were open wide, You held my soul.
Through every broken road, through every tear I know,
Your love was constant, faithful through it all.
And when my faith was weak, Your mercy pulled me close —
YahuShua… You never let me go.
(Verse 2)
There were moments I felt so alone,
Tried to carry every weight on my own.
I was searching for a place to belong,
But Your presence was with me all along.
When I doubted every promise You spoke,
Still Your grace was the anchor of hope.
You were patient through my wandering heart,
Loving me right where I was.
(Chorus)
You never let me go — when I was sinking low,
Your arms were open wide, You held my soul.
Through every broken road, through every tear I know,
Your love was constant, faithful through it all.
And when my faith was weak, Your mercy pulled me close —
YahuShua… You never let me go.
No height, no depth, no fear, no shame,
Could ever take me from Your grace.
Through every doubt, through every scar,
You loved me just the way I was.
And now I stand, my heart restored,
Forever held within Your arms —
You never let me go — through every high and low,
Your love has been the place I call my home.
When all my strength was gone,
You were the faithful One —
The constant light that led my heart back home.
YahuShua… You never let me go.
(You never let me go…)
(You never let me go…)
